newsitem.title: POLAND: Warsaw bourse wants tax relief for companies.
newsitem.headline: Warsaw bourse wants tax relief for companies.

text.p: The Warsaw bourse plans to apply to the finance minister for an exemption of a 20-percent tax on firms raising their capital through a transfer of reserve capital to share capital, the bourse's deputy president said.

"The Warsaw stock exchange decided to submit a proposal to the finance minister regarding tax relief for companies which raise their capital through a transfer of their reserve capital to share capital," Ryszard Czerniawski told a news conference.
"This is only our proposal and at the next meeting the bourse's board will decide on it (applying to the finance minister)," Czerniawski said.
Currently only state-owned joint-stock companies can be exempted from the tax on raising capital through a transfer of reserve capital to share capital.
